request.task: A colleague says: 'Walmart more than doubled its PM openings from the week of July 20 to the week of August 17, and its senior openings that require at least 9 years of product-management experience doubled too.' Check this using company filter 'Walmart' in pai-w-2026-07-20 and pai-w-2026-08-17. For each week report raw records and distinct openings under the published identity rule, and how many distinct openings require at least 9 years of product-management experience under every option the posting offers, citing the qualification text. Assess each half of the claim separately.
